reviewer: Claude Code (AI assistant). Not an independent human review.
method: Reuse families from the 1797 text-reuse run, supplementary phrase searches on all 1,587 pages, reading of every printing, and scan checks of each admitted passage
scan_scope: Each crop covers the excerpt, which is the opening of the printed item. Long items (speeches, dispatches) were not proofread in full.

observations.excerpt_start: NORFOLK, September 28. By a gentleman passenger
observations.excerpt_end: to have landed in town before day
observations.summary: A Norfolk report, from a passenger on a Danish ship, of the British attack on Santa Cruz de Tenerife being driven off.
observations.note: Earliest printing found in the collection. The account continues further down the page.
scan_findings: Scan matches: 'NORFOLK, September 28', 'Christians Haven', '7 English ships', '36 armed boats'.

observations.excerpt_start: NORFOLK, Sept. 18. By a gentleman passenger

new_groups.label: Tenerife defeat report
new_groups.definition: Printings of a Norfolk report, from a passenger on the Danish ship Christian Haven, that the British attack on Santa Cruz de Tenerife (July 1797) was driven off. Other Tenerife accounts in the collection are different texts and are not included.
new_groups.admission_rule: Reviewed 1797 printings of this report, checked against the scan.

new_groups.label: Adams's speech to Congress
new_groups.definition: Printings of President Adams's speech of 16 May 1797 opening the special session of Congress. Pages that only quote phrases from it are not included.
new_groups.admission_rule: Reviewed 1797 printings of the speech text, checked against the scan (opening only).

new_groups.label: Adams's farewell to the Senate
new_groups.definition: Printings of Vice President Adams's farewell address to the Senate (15 February 1797), plus the Senate's answer where printed separately.
new_groups.admission_rule: Reviewed 1797 printings of the address or the answer, checked against the scan.

new_groups.label: Duncan's Camperdown dispatches
new_groups.definition: Printings of Admiral Duncan's official dispatches on the defeat of the Dutch fleet off Camperdown (11 October 1797), from the London Gazette Extraordinary. Earlier first-news reports are not included.
new_groups.admission_rule: Reviewed 1797 printings of the dispatches, checked against the scan (opening only).

new_groups.label: Algerine–Sicilian sea battle
new_groups.definition: Printings of a Civitavecchia report (30 June 1797) of a battle near Messina between an Algerine cruiser and a ship of the King of the Two Sicilies. The battle itself is not independently verified.
new_groups.admission_rule: Reviewed 1797 printings of this report, checked against the scan.

new_groups.label: Blount letter made public
new_groups.definition: Printings of Senator William Blount's intercepted letter to the interpreter James Carey (July 1797): the letter as a document, and a Philadelphia report that introduces and quotes it. The wider Blount affair coverage is not included.
new_groups.admission_rule: Reviewed 1797 printings of the letter or of this report, checked against the scan.

new_groups.label: Brothers boarded by privateer
new_groups.definition: Printings of Captain Kennard's report that the brig Brothers was boarded by a privateer on the way from Grenada to Portsmouth, N.H. (September 1797). Not independently verified.
new_groups.admission_rule: Reviewed 1797 printings of this report, checked against the scan.

new_groups.label: Andrew Brown house fire
new_groups.definition: Reports of the fire at the Philadelphia house of the printer Andrew Brown (27 January 1797) and notices of his death a week later. Several different texts.
new_groups.admission_rule: Reviewed 1797 reports of the fire or of Brown's death, checked against the scan.
